KNIFEHERO-PROUD.title: Proud
KNIFEHERO-PROUD.description: Deals bonus damage equal to your Visibility. While this is in your hand, gain {Amount} Visibility at the end of your turn.
KNIFEHERO-PROUD.extraCardText: Proud: +Visibility damage; +{Amount} Visibility at end of turn while held.
KNIFEHERO-SLAY.title: Slay
KNIFEHERO-SLAY.description: While this is in your hand, at the end of your turn apply Doom to a random enemy equal to the number of Pride cards in your hand.
KNIFEHERO-SLAY.extraCardText: Slay: end of turn, Doom a random enemy = your Pride cards in hand.
KNIFEHERO-SHADY.title: Shady
KNIFEHERO-SHADY.description: While this is in your hand, put a Shiv on top of your draw pile at the end of your turn. When you play this, draw a card.
KNIFEHERO-SHADY.extraCardText: Shady: Shiv on top of your deck at end of turn while held; draw 1 when played.
KNIFEHERO-THORNS.title: Thorns
KNIFEHERO-THORNS.description: When you play this card, gain {Amount} Thorns.
KNIFEHERO-CLONE.title: Clone
KNIFEHERO-CLONE.description: When you play this card, add a copy of it to your hand.
KNIFEHERO-TOP.title: Top
KNIFEHERO-TOP.description: While this is in your hand, gain {Amount} Vigor at the end of your turn.
KNIFEHERO-BOTTOM.title: Bottom
KNIFEHERO-BOTTOM.description: While this is in your hand, gain {Amount} Block at the end of your turn.
KNIFEHERO-WALLING.title: Walling
KNIFEHERO-WALLING.description: While this is in your hand, at the end of your turn gain {Amount} Block for each enchanted card in your hand.
KNIFEHERO-BI.title: Bi
KNIFEHERO-BI.description: While this is in your hand, at the end of your turn deal {Amount} damage twice and gain 1 Visibility.
